title: Duplicator Review
description: A documented profile of Duplicator for WordPress backups, site packages, migrations, and cloning workflows.
metaDescription: A transparently scoped Duplicator WordPress plugin profile from KreativWP.
highlights: The official listing covers backups, migrations, cloning, and restore workflows
It packages WordPress files and database content for transfer or recovery
The plugin offers free functionality alongside paid features
bestFor: Site owners planning a deliberate migration, clone, or recoverable backup workflow and who will test the resulting package before a live change.
researchScope: This profile reviews Duplicator’s official WordPress.org listing. It does not validate a backup’s completeness, hosting compatibility, or recovery time for a particular site.
caveats: A backup is useful only if restoration works. Test a restore on a non-production environment, protect backup files, record credentials and steps, and schedule migration work outside critical periods.
